headlines.text: Trump slaps 50% tariffs on Canada and Carney vows to 'intensify' trade talks. The duties mark a major escalation in trade tensions between the North American neighbours.
US launches fresh strikes on Iran, as Trump warns of retaliation for deaths of soldiers. Iran says it has hit two ships in the Strait of Hormuz as well as targets in Bahrain and Jordan.

Lebanese army says troops deploying in 'pilot zone' after Israeli withdrawal. A US-brokered agreement should see Israeli troops pulling out of a small part of Lebanon occupied during their conflict with Hezbollah.
Row escalates in Ukraine over army chief's future. Protesters are demanding Oleksandr Syrskyi be removed and former defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov reinstated by Friday.
Dozens hurt in Bologna protests after man dies while being restrained by police. Thousands of people took to the streets demanding justice for a Moroccan-born man who died on Sunday.
'Anti-ICE' army veteran started fire outside Manhattan federal building, say officials. Andrew Arrabaca, 43, was armed with two axes, a machete, three knives and fireworks, says the FBI.
Shock and anger after top Ghanaian politician sentenced to 20 years for illegal mining. Bernard Antwi Boasiako, known as "Chairman Wontumi", was also fined more than $10,000 (£7,450).

India's 'cockroach' protest continues a day after police crackdown. Delhi witnessed overwhelming violence on Monday, with at least 60 protesters wounded. Police said 118 of their men were also injured.

Police officers arrested for allegedly seeking roadside bribe from Nigeria's anti-corruption boss. They are accused of stopping Musa Aliyu at a fake roadblock and telling him to drive to a cash machine.

At least 27 dead and 83 missing after passenger ferry capsizes off Guyana. An investigation into the tragedy has been launched, the island's prime minister says, adding he hopes more will be found alive.
Tate brothers appear in US court for extradition proceedings. They were arrested on Saturday after the UK announced dozens of new charges, including rape and sex trafficking, which they deny.
Yemen's Houthis announce 'maritime embargo' on Saudi Arabia. The Houthis say the embargo begins immediately and is a response to a Saudi blockade of ports and airports in Yemen.

Notorious drug cartel leader Ismael Zambada sentenced to life in US prison. Known as "El Mayo", the co-founder the Sinaloa Cartel was also ordered to pay $15bn after he admitted to sending vast amounts of drugs to the US.
Ten killed as Russian attacks on merchant ships in Black Sea intensify. Russian strikes on the Odesa region have killed 28 people in July alone, local authorities say.
Rare identical quadruplets born in Australia. The parents of the four naturally conceived girls were taken by "immense surprise" with the pregnancy, the hospital said.
Guyana recovers 27 bodies after ferry disaster as crew comes under scrutiny. Authorities detain ferry crew members after drug tests reveal violations in Guyana's worst marine disaster in decades.
Why protests are growing in Ukraine over defence leadership and dismissals. Protests continue as anger grows over President Zelenskyy’s decision to fire the country’s defence minister.
Tate brothers vow to fight extradition as they appear at court in Miami. Controversial ‘manosphere’ influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate appeared at a federal court hearing in Miami.
Trump imposes 50% US tariffs on some Canadian goods, citing discrimination. Tariffs apply to Canadian wine, hockey sticks, cement, and other products, sparking fears of escalating trade tensions.
US attacks Iran for 10th consecutive night. Washington vows revenge for US military casualties, while Iran claims attacks on US sites across the region.
Iran war live: Tehran attacks Gulf states, says 2 tankers in Hormuz on fire. Explosions reported in Iran's Bandar Abbas, Qeshm Island, Chabahar and Konarak as US launches new wave of attacks.
MSF demands Israel release detained Palestinian healthcare workers. The NGO is 'outraged' by Israel's treatment of the health professionals and warns that 'silence has become complicity'.
Suspect charged in fatal attack on UK politician Ann Widdecombe. Police say a possible political motive is under investigation in the killing of the Reform UK figure.
Argentina, minus Messi, return home after World Cup final heartbreak. Thousands wait to greet the team, who return without captain Messi and a few other players after the World Cup.
What are the new British Prime Minister’s biggest challenges?. Britain has a new Prime Minister: Andy Burnham. The former Mayor of Manchester must now unite a divided nation.
Chaos in India as ‘Cockroach activists’ march on parliament. Chaos outside India's parliament as protesters tried to storm it; satirical Cockroach Janta Party gains traction.
War on Iran: War resumes 30 days after MoU. 30 days into the US-Iran MoU the worst fighting in months has erupted threatening to unravel the ceasefire.
Moroccan-born man dies while detained by police in Italy. A video showing the final moments of Moroccan-born Abderrahim Fakir as he was detained by police has sparked protests.
World Cup champions Spain return to royal welcome, parade through Madrid. Tens of thousands of fans greet La Roja as they travel down Madrid's historic avenues to Cibeles Square.
Albanian protesters pelt lawmakers’ cars over resort projects. Protesters threw eggs at lawmakers' vehicles outside Albania's parliament, demanding changes to laws.

Darline Graham focuses on kitchen-table issues as she announces full-term Senate bid. Darline Graham tells "Hannity" she plans to focus on groceries, gas prices, and health care rather than foreign policy in her bid for a full Senate term.

Bodycam catches Sunny Hostin invoking her legal chops as cops cite Harvard-grad son for trespassing. Bodycam video captures Sunny Hostin telling MTA police she's a former federal prosecutor after her son Gabriel Hostin was stopped for trespassing.

New York far-left group claims reparations 'owed' as Blacks' median wealth 'nearly 15 times less' than Whites. The NYCLU says Black New Yorkers hold nearly 15 times less median wealth than White residents, citing redlining and slavery's legacy in a new report.

Trump says first call with new UK PM Burnham went 'very well,' pledges US support. Trump pledged U.S. support for Britain's new prime minister after the pair discussed the U.S.-U.K. alliance, trade and Middle East security during their first call.

Sinaloa Cartel boss 'El Mayo' sentenced to life, ordered to pay $15B in drug trafficking profits. Sinaloa Cartel co-founder Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada Garcia received a life sentence and was ordered to forfeit $15 billion in drug trafficking profits.

Michigan Dem hopeful Abdul El-Sayed jabs CNN giving him 'non-consensual colonoscopy' in recent interviews. Democratic Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed took a swipe at CNN during a rally in Grand Rapids, Michigan, over his recent appearances.

Controversial streamer Clavicular explains viral 'looksmaxxing' trend as Gen Z adopts extreme regimen. Braden Peters, known as Clavicular, explained his looksmaxxing philosophy to Sean Hannity, including bone smashing and why he targets young men.

Dodgers' Kiké Hernández blasts fan's angry letter over White House skip, exposes address to followers. Kiké Hernández posted a fan's critical letter and home address to 1.5 million followers after confirming he'd skip the Dodgers' White House visit.

Colorado's socialist candidate calls for 'more immigrants into office' to stop America's 'exploitative' nature. Colorado congressional candidate Melat Kiros called for more immigrants to enter public office and challenge America's exploitative nature on the global stage.

Rand Paul releases docs that reveal FBI halted border inspection of virus researcher over Wuhan lab links. CBP flagged Peter Daszak as a high person of interest over his gain-of-function research ties to the Wuhan Institute of Virology before the FBI intervened.

Johnson's strategy to bypass Democrats' SAVE Act blockade survives key vote, handing GOP big win. Speaker Johnson's plan to put key SAVE America Act provisions into a budget reconciliation bill cleared the House Rules Committee on Monday.

Sydney Sweeney shares bikini and underwear photos in Instagram dump from Australia trip. Sydney Sweeney's Instagram photo dump from Australia features bikini shots, underwear selfies, rock climbing, and cozy moments with Scooter Braun.

Socialist insurgents force moderate Democrats into high-risk showdown over must-hold races. Voices are amplified as Michigan, Wisconsin, become the latest battleground in the battle between the far left and socialists versus the center-left Democratic establishment

Top media networks put on notice after refusing to air Trump's primetime address: 'Serious concerns'. Rep. Buddy Carter asks FCC Chairman Brendan Carr to review whether ABC, NBC and CBS violated public interest obligations over Trump's primetime address.

One cannabis mistake at airport could bring 10 years in prison and $15,000 fine. Thailand's new cannabis penalties include up to 10 years in prison, and a cannabis attorney warns travelers that even a mistake is no excuse abroad. A travel expert weighs in as well.

Powerball ticket sales begin Tuesday in the United Kingdom. Powerball ticket sales in the United Kingdom will begin Tuesday, giving players across the Atlantic a chance at winning the same massive jackpot that U.S. players already play for.

FDA still focused on Taylor Farms lettuce as Cyclospora source despite retracted test. The FDA says lettuce distributed by Taylor Fresh Foods and Taylor Farms de Mexico is still linked to the multistate outbreak of cyclosporiasis. But the source may be difficult to definitively trace.

At Mississippi funeral, Civil Rights leaders call for justice for Nolan Wells, 18. The parents of Nolan Wells, who was found dead on Horn Island in Mississippi, held a funeral for the 18-year-old on Monday. Wells was with friends for the Fourth of July and did not return home.
World Cup: Spain's homecoming heroes. A nation celebrates as Spain's World Cup champions come home to a hero's welcome.

10 things that wowed us at the 2026 World Cup. The United States, Mexico, and Canada co-hosted the nearly six-week tournament. NPR's team of journalists who covered the World Cup reflects on the experience.

Court ruling freezes Paramount-Warner Bros. merger for now. Paramount's owners were hoping they'd be firmly in control of rival Warner Bros. Discovery by the end of this week. Monday's temporary restraining order puts that plan on hold.

India's Gen Z 'Cockroach People's Party' started as satire but is serious about change. They call themselves the "cockroaches" and they're on the march — demanding action against corruption, amid a shortage of opportunities for young people in India.

Putin meets North Korean foreign minister in diplomatic push. The visit by North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui comes without an obvious occasion, such as a multilateral diplomatic event or state anniversary, and has raised speculation that she may be coordinating a possible visit to Russia by North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

3 U.S. personnel killed in Iran conflict. And, Hunter Biden opens up to NPR. Three U.S. service members have been killed since Friday amid rising tension between the U.S. and Iran. And, Hunter Biden talks to NPR's Newsmakers about addiction and public scrutiny.

At least 930 people have died in Congo's Ebola outbreak. Congo's health ministry said the deaths were recorded out of the 2,344 cases confirmed as of Saturday. Thirty-seven new deaths were recorded in the previous 24 hours in one of the highest totals.
